payload.blocks: Phase 10b of component-authority-doors (filling names, primitives and count on every door row) and, after phase 11 closes, phase 12 (retiring the named debt). Phase 11 step 6 waits separately on q-5v6jpbmbcy. Other plans continue.
payload.headline: Who builds, stages and activates a release carrying crate 888bb3563 so phase 10b and then phase 12 can run?

parts.cause: Building, staging and activating a release needs an unconfined session. The lead and the supervisor are both confined, and no unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session is live on fg-server2.

options.cost: One build, stage and activate, about 15 minutes of the owner's time.
options.does: Once npm test and cargo test --workspace are green on main (q-5v6jpbmbcy), the owner builds, stages and activates a release from that main and tells Miu; the supervisor then lets the lead run 10b.
options.gain: One unconfined sitting covers the suite and the release; 10b runs against a tested host.
options.harm: 10b and 12 wait for the owner's next sitting.
options.label: A. Owner releases after the green suite

options.cost: One session start by the owner.
options.does: The owner starts one unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session; the supervisor sends it the suite run and the release as two chores.
options.gain: Later unconfined chores no longer wait on the owner.
options.harm: An unconfined session stays live with broad write access.
options.label: B. Start an unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR

options.does: No release now; 10b and 12 stay parked and the plan closes only when a release happens for another reason.
options.harm: The door guard stays without counts and the named debt stays open with no date.
options.label: C. Hold 10b and 12

parts.recommendation: A: the release must come after a green main anyway, so one sitting clears both waits.

scope.allows: The owner (or a session the owner starts) builds, stages and activates a release from main; the supervisor then restarts or nudges the lead for 10b.
scope.forbids: Any release from the confined lead or supervisor, and any change to the plan's scope or footprint.

parts.what: Phases 10 and 11 of component-authority-doors are on main (3aa23ccc5, 9db8081b4). Phase 10b is parked: the land gate runs the activated host, and the active release still carries the old component-authority crate, which refuses the new names, primitives and count fields.
